onboarding.welcomeDesc: Bloom makes your Linux desktop feel alive.
onboarding.dropOnTheIsland: Drop files or text on it to keep them on the shelf.
onboarding.dockDesc: Your apps and workspaces live down here.
onboarding.rightClickForOptions: Right-click an app for its options and a custom icon.
onboarding.hoverAnEdge: Hover the left or right edge and scroll to adjust.
onboarding.keysDesc: Tap Super to search apps, files and the web, or do quick maths.
onboarding.keysClipboard: Super+V brings back anything you copied.
onboarding.finishShortcuts: Press Super+/ any time for every shortcut.
onboarding.finishUninstall: bloom uninstall puts your previous desktop back.
onboarding.couldntSave: Couldn't save that. Please try again. {{value1}}
